The sounds and pictures Evolute i-Space greets the driver with at start-up: add your own, pick standard ones by season, turn the greeting on and off, and say goodbye when the ignition is switched off.
Developer: AOlifer · Telegram: @oaaspb\ngithub.com/AOlifer/EISWM\nLicense PolyForm Noncommercial: non-commercial use only

Choose a section on the left or with a button on this screen:

Sounds: MP3 files the car plays at start-up and when the ignition is switched off.
Pictures: images on the welcome screen and when the ignition is switched off.

Each section has its own Help. Tap the logo or the title at the top to return to this screen.
⚠ Unofficial app, use at your own risk.

EISWM is an unofficial application. It is not affiliated with, endorsed or supported by the Evolute car manufacturer, its dealers or the head unit suppliers.

The application runs with system privileges and changes data of the stock software: the launcher’s files and database and the welcome settings.

The software is provided “as is”, without warranty of any kind. You install and use it at your own risk. The author is not liable for any damage, including malfunction of the head unit or other vehicle systems, loss of data or settings, the need to reset or reflash the unit, refusal of warranty service, and any consequences while operating the vehicle.

Firmware updates or the manufacturer’s server may change or remove the settings made.

Do not use the application while driving — only while the vehicle is stationary.

The car shows a welcome picture on its screen at start-up. Each time it picks one of them at random.

Tap a picture to see it large.
⋮ save a copy to internal memory or a USB drive, delete the picture.
Add pictures choose PNG or JPG files in internal memory or on a USB drive. Each picture is fitted to the 1920×720 screen; anything beyond the edges is cropped.

The switch on the right turns pictures off: the welcome screen becomes dark, and the pictures are kept and come back when you turn them on.

If the car connects to the manufacturer’s server, the server may erase added pictures. The app keeps copies and restores them when it starts and when the car starts.
